scientific_scope: Three independent domains with independent externally held sealed TEST labels
approval_policy: Before external test, independent organization must be vetted and its unique Ed25519 public key committed to this registry by a recorded human-reviewed PR. The private key remains exclusively with the custodian. Never self-approve using researcher-generated keys or public CI fixtures.
verification_policy: Source identity, disclosure, train/validation, no hidden-label exposure, scoring container isolation, first-and-only final submission and reviewer independence verified separately from signature.
